name: Stripe
description: Trigger Recursive routines from Stripe — completed checkouts, failed payments, subscription changes, refunds, and disputes dispatch agent sessions. Requires a Pro or Teams license.

events.label: Checkout completed
events.description: A Checkout Session finished successfully (payment or subscription started).

events.label: Invoice payment failed
events.description: A payment attempt for an invoice failed (card declined, insufficient funds, …).

events.label: Subscription created
events.description: A customer started a new subscription.

events.label: Subscription canceled
events.description: A customer's subscription ended or was canceled.

events.label: Charge refunded
events.description: A charge was fully or partially refunded.

events.label: Dispute opened
events.description: A customer disputed a charge (chargeback opened).

schema.label: Signing Secret
schema.description: Stripe webhook endpoint signing secret (whsec_…, from Developers → Webhooks → your endpoint → Signing secret). Used to verify inbound requests.

onboarding.subtitle: Connect your Stripe account so payment events fire routines.

steps.title: Add a webhook endpoint in Stripe
steps.desc: Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → Add endpoint, pointed at your Recursive instance's inbound trigger URL.

steps.title: Add your Signing Secret
steps.desc: On the endpoint's page: Signing secret → Reveal (whsec_…). Verifies inbound requests.

steps.title: Verify setup
steps.desc: Confirm the required credentials are in place.
